title: Extended Care Health Option (ECHO) Terms of Coverage for Respite Care and ECHO Home Health Care
content:
Under the Extended Care Health Option (ECHO), respite care and ECHO Home Health Care are covered on the terms below. These terms are identical in every ECHO tier, from Extended Care Health Option, Sponsor E-1 to E-5 through Extended Care Health Option, Sponsor O-9 and O-10.

## ECHO respite care

| Term | Every tier |
|---|---|
| Unit respite is counted in | the hour |
| Most ECHO respite care hours per beneficiary per calendar month | 16 |
| Respite covered only in a month the beneficiary also receives another authorized ECHO benefit | yes |
| Unused respite hours carry to the next month | no |

## ECHO Home Health Care

| Term | Every tier |
|---|---|
| Homebound status required | yes |
| Primary caregiver in the home required | yes |
| Most ECHO Home Health Care respite hours in one day | 8 |
| Most days a week of ECHO Home Health Care respite | 5 |

## What these terms mean for a family

- **Hours, by the month, per beneficiary.** ECHO respite care is counted in hours, up to 16 hours for each beneficiary in each calendar month. Two registered children of one sponsor each have their own 16 hours.
- **Not on its own.** ECHO respite care is covered only in a month in which the beneficiary also receives another authorized ECHO benefit.
- **No banking of hours.** Hours not used in a month do not carry to the next month; each calendar month starts again at 16.
- **ECHO Home Health Care respite.** It is limited to 8 hours in one day and to 5 days in a week, and ECHO Home Health Care requires both that the beneficiary is homebound and that there is a primary caregiver in the home.

*Hypothetical illustrations, for illustration only:*

| Situation in a calendar month | Respite hours covered by the monthly limit |
|---|---|
| A beneficiary uses 10 respite hours in March | 10; the 6 unused hours do not carry into April |
| April begins | the April limit is 16, unchanged by March |
| A week of ECHO Home Health Care respite on 5 days at 8 hours each | within both the daily limit of 8 and the weekly limit of 5 days |
